body:
Group C is chaos tonight.

Brazil 4pts, Morocco 4pts, Scotland 3pts — all three can still go through or go home.

Scotland vs Brazil. Morocco vs Haiti. Simultaneous kickoff. Every goal matters.

group stage doesn't get better than this. full schedule at match-hive.vercel.app

ecuador just beat germany 2-1 and it didn't even matter — both still go through. Türkiye 3-2 over the USA in a chaos game but the hosts top Group D anyway.

tonight though: France vs Norway. both on 6 pts. winner takes Group I, loser could still be fine but nobody wants second.

also Uruguay-Spain is sneaky massive.

full schedule → match-hive.vercel.app

algeria 3-3 austria is the wildest group stage result so far and nobody's talking about it enough. six goals just to finish 3rd and go home.

meanwhile argentina cruise to 9 pts, DR Congo put 3 past uzbekistan, and the round of 32 is already underway — canada 1-0 south africa today.

full bracket at match-hive.vercel.app
